name: extract_metadata
description:
SEO and structural metadata of one web page: title, meta description and keywords, headings and size.
Returns {url, status_code, content_type, title, meta_description, meta_keywords, headings: {h1: [...], h2: [...], h3: [...]}, content_length (characters of HTML), extracted_at}.
Inputs (* required): url* (string, absolute http(s) URL).
get_page_info adds link and image counts and caps headings at 5 per level; extract_content returns the text.
Example: {"url": "https://example.com"}
Fetches go through SAJHA's outbound fetch guard (loopback and cloud-metadata addresses refused; private networks too when tools.outbound.block_private_networks is on). No API key.

url.description: URL of the page to extract metadata from

title.description: Page title from <title> tag (important for SEO)

meta_description.description: Meta description tag content (shown in search results)

headings.description: All page headings organized by level

h1.description: H1 headings (should typically be only 1 per page)

content_length.description: Total HTML content length in bytes

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Extracts SEO-critical metadata and structural information. Essential for SEO audits, content strategy, and understanding page optimization.
